title: Staff Facilities Design Engineer, Wet Mechanical Systems, Solar Manufacturing
description:

As a Senior or Staff Facilities Design Engineer focused on Wet Mechanical Systems, you will own the design direction for liquid\-side utility plants and distribution that keep process tools running: chilled water, process heating water, cooling towers, industrial water, and closely related wet systems. title: Senior Director, Electricity Markets Policy
description:
**Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic and strategic Senior Director of Electricity Markets Policy to lead our efforts in shaping and advancing electricity market policies at the national and regional levels. In this pivotal role, you will drive policy development, foster stakeholder engagement, and advocate for innovative solutions that promote a resilient, sustainable, and equitable energy future. Your expertise will influence legislative and regulatory frameworks, ensuring alignment with industry trends, technological advancements, and environmental goals. This position offers an exciting opportunity to impact the future of electricity markets through strategic leadership, expert communication, and collaborative partnership building.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute comprehensive public affairs strategies focused on electricity market policies, including legislation, regulation, and stakeholder engagement.
* Lead policy research initiatives to analyze current market structures, identify opportunities for reform, and craft actionable recommendations.
* Build and maintain strong coalitions with industry stakeholders, government agencies, community organizations, and advocacy groups to advance shared policy objectives.
* Represent the organization in media relations efforts, including crafting press releases, conducting interviews, and managing social media campaigns to communicate policy positions effectively.
* Engage in legislative affairs by monitoring policy developments, drafting legislative language, and advocating for favorable policies through direct lobbying and coalition efforts.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with legal teams, regulatory experts, communications staff, and technical specialists to ensure cohesive policy messaging and implementation.
